Remove filter Latest User Reviews 2 years ago Good overdrive and distorsion pedal 3 years ago Awesome sounding pedal I cannot praise this pedal enough. I play mainly Metal music. I use it as my main distortion rhythm channel and it sounds awesome. Really powerful, crunchy and lovely tone. The built in sound gate works at treat and stops any unwanted buzzing. Highly recommended pedal 3 years ago One of the best distortions ever!!! I got 4 different distortion sounds only during first 10 minutes, great sound quality, noise gate is too accurate, low noise on line. Get one!!! 7 years ago A killer! This is one of the best investment I've ever made. Maybe the price seems too high, but I guarantee you won't regret buying it 7 years ago Iconic overdrive, but needs a boost in front of it to get the most out of it I get all my guitar tone from my board so I can use a clean amp, and this pedal serves well as a pre-amp stage before a power-amp/speaker simulator. I particularly like the form factor with the sockets at the top and the battery slot underneath. The built-in "smart gate" that only cuts the hiss is a very smart move. Some of the knobs also have a sticking point to show you their "nominal" level (because it's not always at 12 o'clock). Good for fumbling in the dark. I think the passive EQ is a bit lame though, and the boost button is so subtle I don't know why it's there. I have to use a Unit67 boost pedal in front to get the response I want. That said, when set up the way I want it the tone is killer. 10 years ago Sound like Eddy for a mild budget If you are on a budget and want to sound like Eddy, well you can't go wrong with this item. It is very well build and has great features such as the noise gate and boost. Hook up an EVH striped series guitar and you've got yourself a great match.
